pending_interview.category: System design (general) — scalability patterns; designing common systems like a URL shortener, rate limiter, chat system, notification system
pending_interview.question: You are asked to design a URL shortener service — a system where users submit a long URL and get back a short one (like bit.ly/abc123), and anyone who visits the short URL gets redirected to the original. The system needs to handle hundreds of millions of short URLs and tens of thousands of redirect requests per second globally. Walk through your high-level design: what components would you include, how would you handle the scale, and what tradeoffs would you make?
